title: Medieval Europe
description: A whole pub quiz about the Middle Ages: the plague, monasteries, guilds, knights, trade and the crusades.

questions.explanation: It came ashore at Messina in Sicily with ships from the Black Sea and took about three years to cross the continent.

questions.explanation: It is just under seventy metres long and only half a metre high.
